items.name: Venom's Hunger
items.oracle_text:
This spell costs {2} less to cast if you control a Villain.
Destroy target creature. You gain 2 life.
items.zhs_text: 如果你操控反派，则此咒语减少{2}来施放。\n消灭目标生物。你获得2点生命。
items.atomic_translated_text: 如果你操控反派，则此咒语减少{2}来施放。\n消灭目标生物。你获得2点生命。

items.name: Damnation
items.oracle_text: Destroy all creatures. They can't be regenerated.
items.flavor_text: The hunger consumed Venom, and Venom, in turn, consumed the city.
items.atomic_translated_text: 消灭所有生物。它们不能重生。
items.atomic_translated_flavor_text: 饥饿吞噬了毒液，而毒液反过来吞噬了城市。

items.name: Damning Verdict
items.oracle_text: Destroy all creatures with no counters on them.
items.flavor_text: "Yevon is embodied by eternal, unchanging continuity, summoner. Those who question these truths—they are traitors!"
items.zhs_text: 消灭所有其上没有指示物的生物。
items.zhs_flavor_text: 「恒久不变才是耶朋的真谛。不断持续下去的轮回才是耶朋的真谛。和上述真谛唱反调的人，便是叛徒。」
items.atomic_translated_text: 消灭所有其上没有指示物的生物。

items.name: Damn
items.oracle_text:
Destroy target creature. A creature destroyed this way can't be regenerated.
Overload {2}{W}{W} (You may cast this spell for its overload cost. If you do, change "target" in its text to "each.")
items.flavor_text: "So this is the power of the Ring of the Lucii..."
items.atomic_translated_text: 消灭目标生物。以此法消灭的生物不能重生。\n超载{2}{W}{W}（你可以支付此咒语的超载费用来施放它。若你如此作，则将其叙述中的「目标」更改为「每个」。）

items.name: Wrangler of the Damned
items.oracle_text:
Flash
At the beginning of your end step, if you haven't cast a spell from your hand this turn, create a 2/2 white Spirit creature token with flying.

items.zhs_flavor_text: 「伙记，心愿未了这事有好有坏。」

items.name: Army of the Damned
items.oracle_text:
Create thirteen tapped 2/2 black Zombie creature tokens.
Flashback {7}{B}{B}{B} (You may cast this card from your graveyard for its flashback cost. Then exile it.)
items.flavor_text: Sometimes death comes knocking. Sometimes it tears down the walls.
items.zhs_text: 派出十三个已横置的2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。\n返照{7}{B}{B}{B}（你可以从你的坟墓场施放此牌，并支付其返照费用，然后将它放逐。）
items.zhs_flavor_text: 有时死亡会先敲个门。有时它连墙壁都拆掉。

items.name: Overseer of the Damned
items.oracle_text:
Flying
When this creature enters, you may destroy target creature.
Whenever a nontoken creature an opponent controls dies, create a tapped 2/2 black Zombie creature token.
items.zhs_text: 飞行\n当厄亡者督军进战场时，你可以消灭目标生物。\n每当一个由对手操控且非衍生物的生物死去时，你派出一个已横置的2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。
items.atomic_translated_text: 飞行\n当此生物进场时，你可以消灭目标生物。\n每当一个由对手操控且非衍生物的生物死去时，你派出一个已横置的2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。

items.name: The Lost and the Damned
items.oracle_text: Whenever a land you control enters from anywhere other than your hand or you cast a spell from anywhere other than your hand, create a 3/3 red Spawn creature token.
items.flavor_text: The gods of Chaos bestow gifts of mutations upon their champions. Too many of these gifts transform their bearer into mindless, writhing chaos spawn.
items.zhs_text: 每当一个地在你的操控下从你手牌以外的任何区域进入战场或你从你手牌以外的任何区域施放咒语时，派出一个3/3红色后裔衍生生物。
items.zhs_flavor_text: 混沌诸神将变异作为赋礼赐给手下勇士。但这些赋礼大多将主人转化为丧失心智之混沌卵。
items.atomic_translated_text: 每当一个由你操控的地从你手牌以外的任何区域进场或你从你手牌以外的任何区域施放咒语时，派出一个3/3红色后裔衍生生物。
items.atomic_translated_flavor_text: 混沌诸神将变异作为赋礼赐给手下勇士。但这些赋礼大多将主人转化为丧失心智之混沌卵。

items.name: Songs of the Damned
items.oracle_text: Add {B} for each creature card in your graveyard.
items.flavor_text: Not wind, but the breath of the dead.
items.atomic_translated_text: 你坟墓场中每有一张生物牌，便加{B}。

items.name: Bonfire of the Damned
items.oracle_text:
Bonfire of the Damned deals X damage to target player or planeswalker and each creature that player or that planeswalker's controller controls.
Miracle {X}{R} (You may cast this card for its miracle cost when you draw it if it's the first card you drew this turn.)
items.zhs_text: 厄亡者葬火对目标牌手与由他操控的每个生物各造成X点伤害。\n奇迹{X}{R}（当你抓此牌时，如果它是你于本回合抓的第一张牌，你可以支付其奇迹费用来施放它。）
items.atomic_translated_text: 厄亡者葬火对目标牌手或鹏洛客和每个由该牌手或该鹏洛客之操控者操控的生物各造成X点伤害。\n奇迹{X}{R}（当你抓此牌时，如果它是你于本回合抓的第一张牌，你可以支付其奇迹费用来施放它。）

items.name: Ghosts of the Damned
items.oracle_text: {T}: Target creature gets -1/-0 until end of turn.
items.flavor_text: The voices of the dead ring in the heart long after they have faded from the ears.
items.atomic_translated_flavor_text: 亡者之声虽已自耳边消逝，却仍在心中回荡许久。

items.name: Yoke of the Damned
items.oracle_text:
Enchant creature
When a creature dies, destroy enchanted creature.
items.flavor_text: The demon's yoke is part leash, part noose.
items.zhs_text: 生物结界\n当一个生物从场上置入坟墓场时，消灭受此结界的生物。
items.zhs_flavor_text: 恶魔的枷锁一部分是栓绳，一部分是套索。
items.atomic_translated_text: 结附于生物\n当一个生物死去时，消灭所结附的生物。
items.atomic_translated_flavor_text: 恶魔的枷锁一部分是栓绳，一部分是套索。

items.name: Choice of Damnations
items.oracle_text: Target opponent chooses a number. You may have that player lose that much life. If you don't, that player sacrifices all but that many permanents of their choice.
items.flavor_text:
"Life is a series of choices between bad and worse."
—Toshiro Umezawa
items.zhs_text: 目标对手选择一个数字。 你可以让该牌手失去该数量的生命。 若你未如此作，该牌手留下该数量的永久物，其余则牺牲之。
items.zhs_flavor_text: 「生命是一连串的选择，每次都只有糟与更糟可选。」\n～梅泽俊郎
items.atomic_translated_text: 目标对手选择一个数字。你可以让该牌手失去等量的生命。若你未如此作，则该牌手留下该数量的永久物，其余则依其选择牺牲之。
items.atomic_translated_flavor_text: 「生命是一连串的选择，每次都只有糟与更糟可选。」\n～梅泽俊郎

items.name: Wet Willie of the Damned
items.oracle_text: Wet Willie of the Damned deals 2½ damage to any target and you gain 2½ life.
items.flavor_text: Ever the warrior, Glissa responded with a "wedgie from beyond Uranus."
items.atomic_translated_text: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成2½点伤害，且你获得2½点生命。
items.atomic_translated_flavor_text: 格莉莎始终是个战士，她以一记「天外飞靴」还击。

items.name: Screams of the Damned
items.oracle_text: {1}{B}, Exile a card from your graveyard: This enchantment deals 1 damage to each creature and each player.
items.flavor_text: It's important to face your inner demons . . . unless they're the kind of demons that can kill you.
items.zhs_text: 1黑，将你坟墓场中的一张牌移出对战：厄亡者的嘶喊对每个生物和牌手各造成1点伤害。
items.zhs_flavor_text: 你需要面对内在的恶魔…除非那恶魔能够杀死你。
items.atomic_translated_text: {1}{B}，从你的坟墓场放逐一张牌：此结界对每个生物和每位牌手各造成1点伤害。
items.atomic_translated_flavor_text: 你需要面对内在的恶魔…除非那恶魔能够杀死你。

items.name: Temp of the Damned
items.oracle_text:
As this creature enters, roll a six-sided die. This creature enters with a number of funk counters on it equal to the result.
At the beginning of your upkeep, remove a funk counter from this creature. If you can't, sacrifice it.
items.atomic_translated_text: 于此生物进场时，掷一颗六面骰。此生物进场时上面有若干畏惧指示物，其数量等同于掷骰结果。\n在你的维持开始时，从此生物上移去一个畏惧指示物。若你无法如此作，则将它牺牲。
